title: Laasha mila
body:
wa ghurbata wa musibata
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ko yun abbas ka bikhra hua laasha mila
<<DIVIDER>>
do bureeda baazuon ke saath mashkeeza mila
sheh ko yun abbas ka bikhra hua laasha mila
<<DIVIDER>>
bibiyon mein wa-hijaba ka ajab kohraam tha
raaste mein bawafa ka jab kata shaana mila
sheh ko yun abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath malte reh gaye shabbir o zainab dasht mein
ek ghatri mein simat kar maa ko jab dulha mila
sheh ko yun abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ka jee chaaha sakina ko tamache maarta
yun musalmano se usko baap ka pursa mila
sheh ko yun abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mutthiyan kholi gayi bano ki jab marne ke baad
raakh jhoole ki mili aur khoon bhara kurta mila
sheh ko yun abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
boli zainab qaid khane ki ghutan apni jagah
shukr hai saydaniyo ko kam se kam parda mila
sheh ko yun abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
bebasi se gir gaye shabbir jalti rayt par
laasha e akbar par jis dam qasid e sughra mila
sheh ko yun abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
uth gaye tazeem mein ummul baneen ke laal ki
naam le kar koi abid se jo ghazi ka mila
sheh ko yun abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ne bas darvaish maangi marzi e maula e hussain
warna dar se bawafa ke jis ne jo maanga mila
sheh ko yun abbas ka...
